do_not_execute_until: At least one named buyer profile is selected.
Minimum 10 buyer interviews or 3 direct local evidence records support the profile.
Willingness-to-pay is confirmed by at least 2 paid pilots, LOIs, or strong verbal budget confirmations.
Buyer trigger can be detected through Apollo/Hunter/manual lead filters before outbound.

execution_rules: Employees create internal files, briefs, dashboards, task boards, scripts, images, video storyboards, lead tables, and system specs.
Employees may prepare external-action payloads, but emails, posts, purchases, hires, tool changes, payments, and customer contact require explicit approval.
Every employee uses the same current marketing plan, ICP, geography, leads, financial assumptions, and combined company memory.
Unsupported claims, mismatched geography, missing buyer, and missing approval are blockers.
employees_team_tasks.handoff_model: Marketing creates message and assets; Sales/CRM qualifies leads; Systems builds workflows; Legal/QA approve risks; Finance/Data score economics; Operations runs cadence; Success captures retention proof.
